name: Mark Johnston
bio: Mark Johnston is a NASA Solar System Ambassador and VP of the Phoenix Astronomical Society, as well as a Telescope.live Tutor and Ambassador and a 2024 recipient of the Astronomer in Chile Education Ambassador Program. He holds a Master of Outreach from the Astronomical League and an Exceptional Outreach award from the Night Sky Network, and serves as the astronomer for the Four Seasons resort. He was named Volunteer of the Year by the City of Scottsdale for his astronomy programs at Pinnacle Peak Park, and supports visual, night vision, EAA, and hydrogen alpha solar observing programs.
